text:
Nobody:

AI: 'Per my last email regarding the aforementioned matter, I hope this message finds you well during these unprecedented times in which we find ourselves...'

Me: I just asked for a casual Tuesday check-in.
reason: Everyone relates to AI being too formal. Relatable humor drives replies.

text:
My AI agent just suggested I 'circle back next week' on a project I haven't started.

Sir, this is a Wendy's.

I mean, this is my living room.
reason: Work culture humor + AI weirdness. Funny and relatable.

text:
🧠 Expanding brain:

Normal: Write an email yourself
Big: Use AI to draft it
Galaxy: AI predicts what you want to say
Universe: AI sends it before you think of it

Me still struggling with Normal
reason: Expanding brain meme format. Visual + relatable progression.

text: POV: You asked AI to summarize a 10-page report and it somehow made it 12 pages.
reason: POV format + relatable AI failure. Quick and funny.

text:
Just asked AI to design my 'dream workspace' and it put a hammock over a hot tub inside a glass dome surrounded by redwood trees.

You know what? Let's do it.
reason: Shows AI being unexpectedly creative. Wholesome + funny.

text:
AI: 'I've analyzed your calendar and determined you're most productive between 2-4am on Tuesdays.'

Me: That's called insomnia.
reason: Work culture humor. Everyone's had AI be weirdly confident.

text:
🎲 Let's play: AI Generated Startup or Real Thing I Found on LinkedIn?

'Uber but for trees. We plant them for you.'

(It's real. Someone actually raised money for this. I'm not mad, I'm impressed.)
reason: Startup culture satire. Taps into 'crazy startup ideas' trend.

text:
Me: Write a casual out-of-office message

AI: 'Greetings esteemed colleagues, I shall be indisposed from the hours of...'

Me: I said CASUAL.
AI: 'I am away. Do not email me. I beg you.'

Closer.
reason: Relatable back-and-forth. Shows AI personality struggles humorously.

text:
My AI just ranked my weekend priorities as:

1. Meal prep
2. Exercise
3. 'Touch grass'

Thanks AI, I'll get right on that grass-touching.
reason: Gen Z/internet humor. 'Touch grass' is trending. Relatable self-care humor.

text: Hot take: AI is just a very confident intern who knows how to Google really fast.
reason: Contrarian but true. Simple, quotable, shareable.

text:
Just had AI write a breakup text to my subscription services.

'Dear Netflix, it's not you, it's my bank account. We've had some good times but I need to see other... cheaper options.'

I feel alive.
reason: Personal story + humor. Shows creative AI use case. Relatable (everyone has too many subs).

text:
The three stages of using AI:

1. This is amazing
2. Wait that's wrong
3. Oh no I'm arguing with a computer

Currently at stage 3.
reason: Everyone goes through these stages. People will reply with their stage.

text:
Plot twist: AI isn't replacing humans.

We're just outsourcing being wrong to the cloud.
reason: Clever twist on AI fear narrative. Funny and unexpected.

text:
Unhinged AI moment of the day:

Asked it to write a motivational quote. It gave me 'The grind never stops because if it did, it would be called the grind that stopped.'

Deep. Profound. I'm inspired.
reason: 'Unhinged' is trending. Shows AI being weirdly literal/funny.

text:
Let's normalize asking AI stupid questions.

Me: 'What's the best way to eat cereal?'
AI: 'With a spoon, in a bowl, preferably not in the shower.'

Okay but I didn't say I was in the shower.

Wait... how did it know?
reason: Funny interaction. Shows AI being weirdly specific. Relatable 'talking to AI' humor.
